scope: Node logic/read-only adapter; no browser/audio listening proof

checks.name: Exact weapon fire mapping, no hit before actual collision event
Duplicate and shuffled batch consume once in monotonic sequence
Late old event after a later batch is rejected
New generation accepts restarted seq and rejects previous generation context
Current explicit context rejects prior voyage or generation tagged entries
Mismatched current snapshot/context cannot reset current identity
Old voyage is retired after a new voyage and cannot replay its history
Invalid seq, missing generation, malformed event and unsupported event rejected safely
Material lookup reads hull/balloon/armor/engine with destroyed and detached modules
Player and untyped obstacle use conservative wood impact fallback
Weapon-specific hit gain/rate preserves material distinctions
Actual field repair requires restored HP and anchors to the player
Cut, detached bundle and actual recovered ownership are distinct source events
Clear-combat stops voices and keeps seq cursor within the same generation
Pause drains backlog, stops loops and resumes without an old hit burst
Hidden tab consumes and clears, then discards accumulated hidden history
Maintenance stops loops and drains old events without changing combat authority
Defeat clears active one-shots and loops
Retry establishes next generation and rejects all old generation events
Same-identity reset never lowers cursor; baseline explicitly suppresses retained history
Map switch clears voices and replaces ambience without a second simulation
Identical frame updates never duplicate loop start commands
Locked loop start is retried on unlock; runtime clear/mute can recover on the next state sync
Speed updates existing loop parameters only; danger has a separate transition cue
Actual harbor transition returns once even when settlement save failed
Victory then harbor transition cannot double-play return
Repair/equip/save audio follows explicit command success or failure only
Initial harbor command confirmation works without a voyage or generation
Distance and pan use provisional XZ, camera right and attenuation
Inputs remain byte-identical and deeply frozen snapshots are supported
Long logical input uses bounded identity/loop storage and no per-shot maps
Dispose is idempotent and ignores later reads, commands and hidden changes
Audio and UI callback errors are isolated from combat readers
Frozen controller source: actual fire/hit, command salvage and return read without audio mutation
